name: Land

v1.prompt: The cat lands from a jump: front paws touch down first, the body compresses into a soft crouch as the back paws land, then it rises back to a normal standing pose facing right. Tail swings down then up. The cat stays in place.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: usable: AutoSprite starts every clip from the standing base pose, so no touchdown from the air; frames 8-19 are a good crouch-and-recover squash
suggest: frames 8-19, every other frame (6 frames) at 20 fps = 0.3 s
